title.ja: 軍人を装う『緊急転勤』取引詐欺

short_desc.ja: 軍人身分で OLX 等の売買に登場し『緊急転勤』を口実に送金を奪う
short_desc.en: 'Army officer' pretext on OLX etc. demands advance payment.

cultural_lever.ja: 軍人への敬意と、緊急転勤という現実感
cultural_lever.en: Respect for the armed forces; plausibility of urgent postings

scenario.ja: 1) OLX 等で軍人を装う売り手・買い手 2) 身分証やユニフォーム画像を提示 3) 緊急転勤・現地受取不可を口実 4) 前払いや UPI 送金を要求
scenario.en: 1) Pose as army seller/buyer on OLX 2) Show ID or uniform photos 3) 'Urgent posting' pretext 4) Demand advance / UPI payment

ja: 軍人身分と緊急転勤の説明
対面での現物確認を拒否
QR や UPI での前払い要求
身分証画像を信用しない
1930 または cybercrime.gov.in へ通報

legal_notes.ja: I4C が 2022 年7月に公告

references.label: I4C Advisory: Fraudsters using Army personnel details to perpetrate financial cyber frauds
references.quote: Fraudsters using Army personnel details to perpetrate financial cyber frauds July 06 2022 As per the analysis of recent complaints reported on NCRP of I4C, a new trend in financial cyber fraud has been observed where fraudsters impersonate.....

verification.note: I4C 公告が、手口（Army personnel details を悪用）、位置づけ（a new trend in financial cyber fraud）を明示。OLX 詐欺はインドで広く注意喚起
